# Benchmark International Middle Market

> Benchmark International's Middle Market team represents privately held companies across the United States with $50M–$500M in total enterprise value (TEV) in sell-side M&A, recapitalizations and growth partnerships, across five sectors: Industrial, Business Services, Consumer, Healthcare, Technology.

Information as of October 2026. Contact: 813-771-6675, mmt@benchmarkintl.com. Parent firm: Benchmark International (https://www.benchmarkintl.com/).

## Sectors
- [Industrial](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/sectors/industrial.html): Manufacturing, industrial distribution, building products, energy and environmental services, and transportation.
- [Business Services](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/sectors/business-services.html): Commercial and facility services, marketing and tech-enabled services, engineering and consulting, financial and insurance services, and staffing and human capital.
- [Consumer](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/sectors/consumer.html): Food and beverage (including restaurants), consumer brands and products, foodservice and distribution, and consumer services.
- [Healthcare](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/sectors/healthcare.html): Provider services, life sciences and diagnostics, medical products and distribution, and pharmacy and healthcare services.
- [Technology](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/sectors/technology.html): Vertical software, enterprise and infrastructure software, IT and managed services, and communications and hardware.

## Sector reports
- [Industrial Q4 2026 M&A Sector Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/industrial-sector-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/industrial-sector-report-q4-2026.pdf), [Markdown](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/industrial-sector-report-q4-2026.md)): Order books are full, the deal market has become more selective and buyers are paying the most for power, data center, aerospace and service revenue.
- [Business Services Q4 2026 M&A Sector Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/business-services-sector-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/business-services-sector-report-q4-2026.pdf), [Markdown](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/business-services-sector-report-q4-2026.md)): Mergers and acquisitions across commercial, professional and human capital services
- [Consumer Q4 2026 M&A Sector Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/consumer-sector-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/consumer-sector-report-q4-2026.pdf), [Markdown](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/consumer-sector-report-q4-2026.md)): Strategic and financial buyers stayed active across the consumer sector through the third quarter, and they are paying for brands and operators that have held price and volume while the cost of financing a purchase rises.
- [Healthcare Q4 2026 M&A Sector Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/healthcare-sector-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/healthcare-sector-report-q4-2026.pdf), [Markdown](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/healthcare-sector-report-q4-2026.md)): Mergers and acquisitions across provider services, life sciences, medical products and pharmacy services
- [Technology Q4 2026 M&A Sector Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/technology-sector-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/technology-sector-report-q4-2026.pdf)): Managed IT and cloud services, cybersecurity, telecom and UCaaS, systems integration, electronics and hardware, and government technology: the deal market, the policy calendar and what buyers are paying for.

## Common questions
- **What does Benchmark International's Middle Market team do?** Benchmark International's Middle Market team represents privately held companies across the United States in sell-side M&A, recapitalizations and growth partnerships.
- **What size companies does the Middle Market team advise?** The team serves privately held companies with a total enterprise value (TEV) of $50 million to $500 million.
- **Which sectors does the Middle Market team focus on?** Five sectors: Industrial, Business Services, Consumer, Healthcare and Technology.
- **What services does the Middle Market team provide?** Services include sell-side M&A, recapitalizations and partial sales, strategic partnerships and growth capital, and exit planning and valuation.
- **How does working with Benchmark International start?** The first step is always a confidential conversation about your goals, your company and your options. A senior member of the Middle Market team sets up a private conversation, then walks you through the paths available, from a partial recapitalization to a full sale.
- **How large is Benchmark International?** Benchmark International is the #1 privately owned sell-side M&A advisor worldwide, based on PitchBook's Q2 2026 Global League Tables, with 15 offices across the Americas, Europe and Africa.
- **How do I contact the Middle Market team?** Call 813-771-6675 or email mmt@benchmarkintl.com.
